notes: Recorded under the owner's AFK mandate, extended by the ruling of 2026-09-06 which directs continuation through the ranked remainder after the replay-store seam. Item 2 of that remainder is the shared Redis/etcd stores, measured by the #824 census at 1 of 5 files owned and named there as the mechanisms ASM-0040 and ASM-0041 name. Recorded by the implementing agent as routine owner-review maintenance, not as a transcription of a ruling naming this fingerprint. TWO UNITS AND TWO THEOREMS, NEVER ONE UNION: two mechanisms, two premises, two feature lanes, and THM-0092's own scope already insists that the two are NOT equally strong and that its claim does not level them. A single unit spanning both would also require both features at once, which ADR-MCPRE-061 records as the shape invisible to every single-feature lane. THE PREMISE AND THE THEOREM ANSWER DIFFERENT QUESTIONS and the registration keeps them apart. ASM-0040 and ASM-0041 are about what an ACKNOWLEDGED insert durably established; they are foreign, per mechanism, and unchanged. These theorems are about what happens when there is NO acknowledgement, and about the configuration that would silently invalidate the premise. Neither theorem is evidence for its premise and neither strengthens it. THE DEPENDENCY EDGE IS A GENUINE MISSING EDGE, found by asking top-down what the root requires rather than upward from the registry. THM-0092's security consequence is explicitly about a deployment that serves a replayed request as fresh because the store it was supposed to consult was unreachable. Its own battery measures that against a STUB store that errors; nothing measured that the DEPLOYED adapters error rather than returning Fresh. THM-0092 therefore now depends on THM-0106 and THM-0107, and the closure now includes results measured only in feature lanes — which is honest, because the root's claim about fleet-strict deployments genuinely rests on backends that exist only in those lanes. LANE IDENTITY IS PART OF THE EVIDENCE: a plain cargo test --workspace compiles both adapter files to zero tests, so each unit names its own test_features. verify-mutations has honoured test_features only since #822; before that fix every probe over these batteries would have returned MEASUREMENT FAILURE rather than a result. TWENTY-TWO CONTROLS HERE WERE NAMED BY NO UNIT. TWO CONJUNCTS EXCLUDE OUTCOMES THAT ARE NOT OBVIOUSLY REPLAY BUGS AND ARE. First, lease cleanup is fail-SAFE and never fail-closed: a revoke that fails still answers Replay, because the nonce's status is already known and turning a bookkeeping failure into a refusal would convert it into a denial of service. Second, the per-operation deadline is clamped at BOTH ends and applies to all three POSTs — an awaited future that never completes holds its request and its admission slot forever, so a black-holed endpoint would consume the whole --max-in-flight budget without a single invalid request being sent; zero would fail every insert closed, and an unclamped large value is the black hole again. Probes M126 and M127 red-verified on this tree. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED, in the scope: nothing about durability or consensus, which is ASM-0041; not a liveness claim; and the protocol is measured against SCRIPTED GATEWAYS and pure helpers rather than a live etcd cluster, so what is established is that this adapter sends the put-if-absent it claims to send, reads the reply it claims to read, and fails closed on everything else — never that a real cluster answers as the protocol says. A live-cluster exercise is separate evidence and is not claimed.
